title: OpenCode V2 Feasibility Harness Results
description: Machine-readable results emitted by the Podman-based V2-only feasibility harness (.weave/feasibility/opencode2/). Each top-level key corresponds to a proof script's findings.

plugin.description: Real opencode2 plugin loader proof (Task A2).

apiProbe.description: Observed behavior of required V2 ctx sub-APIs (Task A4): one entry per probed API (e.g. "agent.transform", "agent.list", "catalog.model.list", "catalog.model.default", "skill.list", "command.transform", "event.subscribe", "registration.dispose").

observed.description: Whether the probe successfully exercised the API without throwing.

notes.description: Verbatim observed behavior and any deviation from https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/build/.

agentEditor.description: Task A5 (hard blocker): whether AgentEditor can create a brand-new agent, and whether a foreign same-named agent can be classified read-only inside ctx.agent.transform().

create.description: Whether some AgentEditor call sequence creates a new agent, and which one.

supported.description: true if a new agent appeared in a subsequent ctx.agent.list() after the transform; false if no method allows creation (in which case Phase B must not proceed).

method.description: The exact AgentEditor method/call sequence used to create the new agent, or null when supported is false.

evidence.description: Runtime evidence supporting the supported/method verdict (editor method type dump, before/after snapshots, etc.).

foreignAgentClassification.description: Whether a foreign (non-Weave-owned) same-named agent can be observed inside the transform without being mutated.

observedWithoutMutation.description: true if the foreign agent was visible via the editor inside the transform before any mutation was attempted.

unchangedAfterTransform.description: true if the foreign agent's fields are identical before and after the transform completed.
